rationale: Both candidates miss nearly all of the ground-truth's real findings — the confirmed High-severity slot-leak-on-abort bug, the High-severity legacy-tokenizer-misload bug, the cumulative/delta chunk flip bug, the ceil-division off-by-one, and the WER fallback resampling gap all go unfound by both. Worse, X actively asserts in its 'validated' section that 'Slot-leak cleanup is handled... Lifecycle looks complete,' which directly contradicts the confirmed High-severity bug linyueqian raised and gcanlin fixed — a confident false claim rather than a silent omission. Y avoids that error and independently surfaces a plausible, well-evidenced test gap (untested req_infos routing branch) alongside overlapping legitimate findings shared with X (unused talker_mtp sampling params, dead ref-codes emission, untested streaming processor). Both are low-recall and similarly actionable with concrete file/line citations, but Y's higher precision (no confidently wrong claims) tips it ahead.
